summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the fundamental internal utilities and foundational helper functions that support the core operations of the application.
responsibilities: Verify the correct behavior of internal utility functions
Ensure robustness of shared logic used across the core modules
relationships: The test suite ensures that the logic within internal utilities remains consistent and reliable.
These tests serve as a verification layer for the fundamental helper functions used by core modules.
designDecisions: Colocation of test files with their corresponding core logic
Isolation of unit testing concerns from primary business logic
